# IFTIKHARI Marriage Hall - Wedding & Event Venue
> Premium wedding and event venue located in Hazara Town, Quetta, Pakistan.

## Overview
IFTIKHARI Marriage Hall offers an elegant, air-conditioned indoor venue for weddings, Walima, Barat, Nikah, engagements, birthday parties, and award ceremonies.

- Capacity: 50 to 500 Guests
- Location: Near Ameeri Taj Mahal Marriage Hall, Hazara Town, Quetta (Plus Code: 5XM5+F3J)
- Pricing: Starting from PKR 50,000 to PKR 100,000+
- Power: Dual continuous backup (Generator + UPS)
- Parking: Secure parking for 10 Cars and 100 Motorcycles
- Catering: Both in-house and outside catering allowed
